Title: Karan and the Family

Cast

1. Karan - 28 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Neeta - 56 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Ajay - 37 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Meenakshi - 27 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
5. Sunita - 34 years, friend
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Karan stands by the road. Neeta stands near him.]

Karan: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Karan rides his motorbike to the market.]

Karan: "That was fun!"

[Karan starts his scooter and rides off.]

Karan: "That's great!"

[Karan drives the car to the office.]

Karan: "That was such a fun day!"
